article.title: Returns and refunds: Apparel (US)
article.body:
## Overview
This article explains returns for clothing (jackets, base layers, pants and accessories) bought from Northbeam Outfitters and delivered to the United States.

## Return window
You can return eligible apparel within 45 days of delivery for a full refund to the original payment method.

## Condition
Items must be unwashed and unworn, with tags attached.

## Restocking fee
There is no restocking fee for this product line.

## Return shipping
Return shipping is free: print the prepaid label from your order page.

## Refund timing
Refunds are issued within 5 business days after the warehouse receives your return.

## How to start a return
Sign in, open Order History, choose the order and select Start a return. Have your order number ready.

article.title: Expedited shipping: the United States
article.body:
## Expedited shipping to the United States
Expedited delivery takes 2 to 3 business days after the order leaves our warehouse and costs $19.95 per order.

## Tracking
You will receive a tracking link by email when the parcel ships. Orders placed on weekends ship the next business day.

article.title: Basecamp 3 Tent: specifications and warranty
article.body:
## Specifications
The Basecamp 3 Tent sleeps three, weighs 2.6 kg and has two doors and two vestibules.

## Collection
The Basecamp 3 Tent belongs to the camping gear line.

## Warranty
The Basecamp 3 Tent is covered by a 3 year warranty against defects in materials and workmanship.

article.title: Alpine 40 Pack: care and cleaning
article.body:
## Care
Hand wash the pack in a tub with mild soap; do not machine wash. Never use bleach.

## About this product
The Alpine 40 Pack is part of our packs and bags collection.

article.title: Holiday returns 2026
article.body:
## Extended holiday returns
Items purchased between November 1 and December 24, 2026 can be returned until January 31, 2027. All other return conditions still apply.

article.title: Lumen 400 Headlamp: warranty and troubleshooting
article.body:
## Warranty
The Lumen 400 Headlamp is covered by a 2 year warranty against defects in materials and workmanship.

## Troubleshooting
If the headlamp does not turn on, charge it for at least 2 hours with the supplied USB-C cable.

## Flickering after firmware 2.1
If the light flickers on high after the 2.1 firmware update, remove the battery for 30 seconds, reinsert it and hold the power button for 5 seconds.

article.title: Returns and refunds: Footwear (Canada)
article.body:
## Overview
This article explains returns for footwear (hiking boots, trail runners and sandals) bought from Northbeam Outfitters and delivered to Canada.

## Return window
You can return eligible footwear within 60 days of delivery for a full refund to the original payment method.

## Condition
Items must be unworn outdoors, with the original box and tags.

## Restocking fee
There is no restocking fee for this product line.

## Return shipping
A prepaid return label costs C$9.95 and is deducted from your refund.

## Refund timing
Refunds are issued within 7 business days after the warehouse receives your return.

## How to start a return
Sign in, open Order History, choose the order and select Start a return. Have your order number ready.

article.title: Price adjustments
article.body:
## Our own price drops
If the price of an item you bought drops on northbeam.example within 14 days of purchase, we refund the difference. Request it from Order History.

## Sales
This also applies when an item goes on sale.
